findings.implementation: Option B implemented. The gate counts same-name relations in the effective search_path via pg_catalog.current_schemas(false) and fails closed with the independent error category errAppendOnlyTableAmbiguous when the count is not 1. The existing pg_table_is_visible count check is retained and runs first; the two checks are additive.

adr_divergence_handoff.divergence_observed_at_review: The R02 review found that ADR-0029 sections 5 and 8 still described provision.sql plus grant-application.sql as a mandatory two-phase install, while the R02 implementation performs migrations with the migration identity, then REVOKEs UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on the two append-only tables and REVOKE ALL on schema_migrations before the gate; grant-application.sql is out-of-band replay/verification.
adr_divergence_handoff.current_working_tree_state: The framework.md working-tree copy already contains Lead revision text at line 910 and updated section 5 (line 893) and section 8 (line 896) describing startup auto-REVOKE plus out-of-band grant-application replay. This agent did not modify any ADR or decisions file.
adr_divergence_handoff.recommended_action: Lead should use add-adr-decision to confirm or ratify ADR-0029 sections 5 and 8 as already drafted in the working tree: startup auto-REVOKE as the fresh-install path, grant-application.sql as out-of-band replay/verification. No ADR change is made in this round.

notes: The first integration negative-control attempt failed because the decoy schema had no USAGE for the application role; current_schemas(false) is privilege-aware and excluded it, so the gate correctly passed. The harness was corrected by granting USAGE on the decoy schema; the gate code was not weakened.
No schema or role was dropped in R03. All runs append to retained-resources.ndjson and prior entries are preserved.
A concurrent Lead gate run appended two more schema groups and lead-gate.log at 09:32Z. They are recorded here and retained; this agent did not create, modify, or delete them.
main.go, provision.sql and grant-application.sql were not modified; before and after SHA256 are equal.
The R02 evidence directory and existing registries were not modified.

The README wording was corrected after run-06/07 to state the actual not-1 fail-closed semantics and error-category ordering; run-09 re-ran go build on the final working-tree state. Go source hashes were unchanged by that correction.
The 11 pre-existing integration subtests were not made slower or flaky; the added 12th subtest completed in 0.25s (normal) and 0.28s (race).

redaction.reason: S15-ACL-R03-F001: plaintext local-dev superuser password removed from recorded command lines and postgres.dsn. No file, log line, or evidence was removed; token replaced with <redacted> and log_sha256 values added for the affected logs.

not_proven: Real deployment, CI, credential distribution, credential rotation, and backup/restore are not proven.
The service does not set or prove that search_path points at the schema provisioned by deploy/db/provision.sql; operators must configure both DSNs explicitly.
Historical same-name schemas are not cleaned up. Schemas without USAGE are excluded by current_schemas(false); the gate cannot prove that all historical schemas are isolated.
The public schema owner change risk documented in deploy/db/README.md is not proven or exercised in a real cluster.
Database-wide least privilege outside the two append-only tables is not proven.
Column-level ACL coverage beyond the checked INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE columns and aclexplode(attacl) DELETE entries is not proven.
The actual listener socket was not observed; the gate runs before listener startup by code order only.
The concurrent Lead gate artifacts were not independently reviewed by this agent.
